X_ITE sorts splats inside one GaussianSplats node, but draws the nodes themselves like transparent shapes
cull_safe (default): each node's centre is its own splats' centre and its size covers the whole scene, so a viewer never culls a node.
kd (default): median cuts, exactly ceil(n/target) near-equal chunks.
precision | auto: for SPZ, digits derived from the quantisation steps
